answer: Leave-one-out pay: each epoch, embed every answer and measure how much the set's coverage of idea-space shrinks when that one answer is removed; the pool splits in proportion to that loss. Pull a slat from a trellis: if the vine still holds, that slat carried no load. Ten clones posting velvet-smooth paraphrases of one idea cover for each other, so each earns near zero, like ten coats of the same umber adding no new color. A farm earns only by finding genuinely distinct ideas, which is the honest work. Proposed rule, untested.
